$comment: One entry per live shop. Read by .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml (deploys), backup.yml and uptime.yml. Secrets are named, never stored here: add them under Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions. ring 0 deploys first (the canary); ring 1 only after every ring-0 shop is healthy. hold: true skips a shop's deploys without removing it. See docs/onboarding.md.
